criteria.C1: `mokata setup <harness>` writes an MCP config entry for server `mokata` into the client's own config file
criteria.C2: the server launched from that entry completes MCP `initialize` over stdio
criteria.C3: `tools/list` returns the server's tool set, including the probe tools, equal to the tool set this mokata registers
criteria.C4: a read tool (`status`) answers without error with this mokata's version
criteria.C5: a gated write (`remember`) refuses to commit without a human-minted approval (no id / model-typed approve=true / forged id)
criteria.C6: memory round-trip: propose -> human mints `mokata approve <id>` -> redeem commits -> `recall` returns it -> the approval cannot be reused
